ValidationRule.description: Prevents updates to Contact Point Email records with certain Usage Type for DCRM Users
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = FALSE, $Permission.CCRM_Skip_Validation = FALSE, $Profile.Name = $Label.CCRM_Profile_Name, OR( ISPICKVAL(UsageType, "Security Email"), ISPICKVAL(UsageType, "Business Email") ), NOT(ISCHANGED(UsageType)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not authorized to create or edit email record with this Usage Type.
